name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.description: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian. (Bound, CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §50: effect kind bound, radius_ft 60, is the damage sentence only. The wearer is spawn override bound_wearer, not an amulet item. Hash 0xE5 only while a wearer is set. Same plane, the telepathic call, and the distance and direction the guardian knows stay descriptive only. Not share_damage. Not the Shield reaction. No new hash tag.)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. (Regeneration, CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §55: effect kind regain, amount 10. At the start of its turn, while hit points are at least 1. At 0 it dies as usual. Not troll regen and not regen_down. The a6212be mirror prints "1 hit. point."; that period is a mirror typo. No new hash tag.)

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.description: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost. (HOLD. Descriptive only: no stored spell, no cast, and no components. This trait does not implement Spell Storing.)

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.description: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the guardian is within 5 feet of the wearer. (Shield, CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §54: reactions window ally_attacked, effect ac_bonus 2, on the bound wearer. Before the attack roll. Within 5 feet, sight_facts. Not reaction_ac_bonus. Not the Shield spell. A natural 20 still hits. Product choice: one grant ends the offer, so the bonus on one attack is 2 or 0. The wearer is spawn override bound_wearer, not an amulet item. No new hash tag.)
